cast.name: Dark Spot & Uneven Tone

lines.speaker: villain
lines.bn: আজ রাতে, এই মুখ আমাদের দখলে!
lines.or: ଆଜି ରାତିରେ, ଏ ମୁହଁ ଆମ କବଜାରେ!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Glow Fusion Night Patrol, reporting for duty.

lines.speaker: jar
lines.or: କୋଜିକ ଏସିଡ, ଡାର୍କ ସ୍ପଟ ଟାର୍ଗେଟ କର!

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Niacinamide, support a brighter, even-looking tone.

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Alpha arbutin, join the brightening patrol.

lines.speaker: jar
lines.en: Three actives. One powerful night formula.
lines.bn: তিনটে অ্যাক্টিভ, এক পাওয়ারফুল নাইট ফর্মুলা!
lines.ta: மூணு ஆக்டிவ்ஸ், ஒரே பவர்ஃபுல் நைட் ஃபார்முலா!
lines.te: మూడు యాక్టివ్స్, ఒకే పవర్‌ఫుల్ నైట్ ఫార్ములా!
lines.ml: മൂന്ന് ആക്ടീവ്സ്, ഒരൊറ്റ പവർഫുൾ നൈറ്റ് ഫോർമുല!
lines.or: ତିନି ଆକ୍ଟିଭ, ଏକ ପାୱାରଫୁଲ ନାଇଟ ଫର୍ମୁଲା!

lines.speaker: woman
lines.en: Brighter, more even-looking, ready to glow.
lines.bn: ব্রাইটার, আরও ইভন লুকিং, গ্লো রেডি!
lines.ta: பிரைட்டர், இன்னும் ஈவன் லுக்கிங், க்ளோ ரெடி!
lines.te: బ్రైటర్, మరింత ఈవెన్ లుకింగ్, గ్లో రెడీ!
lines.ml: ബ്രൈറ്റർ, കൂടുതൽ ഈവൻ ലുക്കിങ്, ഗ്ലോ റെഡി!
lines.or: ବ୍ରାଇଟର, ଆଉ ଇଭେନ ଲୁକିଙ୍ଗ, ଗ୍ଲୋ ରେଡି!

notes: Product-avatar ad. Three voices: villain (0.0-1.88, low ~127 Hz growl), jar mascot (~240-265 Hz, all ingredient/brand lines), woman (15.12-17.02, ~209 Hz). Line 7 'Retreat!' is the villain per prompt but delivered as a high panicked squeal (~404 Hz) as it shrinks; only 0.0-1.88 used as villain clone ref. Whisper heard 'Dermadoc' for DERMDOC in line 9. In line 9 the word 'Formula' is dropped in all dubs to fit the 2.4 s slot (Glow Fusion Formula is on the end slate). Brightening wording kept as 'brighter/brightening' and 'even tone' only, no fairness claims. Text pass (client feedback EDL): L8 hedged to 'more even-looking'; L9 is now the product name ('overnight brightener' moved to an on-screen super); dubs say 'DERMDOC Kojic Acid Night Cream' without 'two percent' because this video already runs at max tempo.
